source.notes:
## CROSS-CUTTING RULE — help-surface parity

Applies to every child bead that adds, removes, or changes a CLI flag / subcommand / semantic behavior:

**The same PR MUST update the corresponding `--help` output.** No PR ships CLI code changes without matching help text. Help is canonical (per DOC-04 top-file rule); shipping code without help propagates drift the audit already flagged.

Also updates the same PR:
- Package README section that mirrors the flag/subcommand
- Changelog entry (auto-refresh handles Unreleased; verify entry names the flag)
- If the flag has a corresponding skill mention (in `.xtrm/skills/default/**/SKILL.md`), update it OR file a follow-up drift bead

Reviewer gate: reject any PR that changes CLI behavior without a `--help` diff in the same commit range.

Enforcement (soft, Sprint 3): EVAL-02's `check-forbidden-phrases.mjs` may add an out-of-scope guard — but the primary enforcement is human/reviewer discipline in every PR.

source.description:
## PROBLEM

Sprint 0 (xtrm-wiy5n.1.1) attempted to slim `.xtrm/skills/default/using-specialists/SKILL.md` from 256 lines to the 120–150 target from the 2026-07-24 audit reconcile. That edit tripped `check:specialists-vendor` because `using-specialists` is a specialists-owned skill, vendored into xtrm-tools via `.xtrm/specialists-source.json`. Editing the vendored copy directly violates the ownership contract (CLAUDE.md gotchas) and the hash gate rejects it.

The slim itself is desirable — the router-style shape lands, the SCRUTINY/Escalation Matrix/Draft/Bead-title verbosity moves to references (which already exist). Just needs to happen in the right repo.

## SUCCESS

- `~/dev/specialists/config/skills/using-specialists/SKILL.md` slimmed to ≤150 lines (target 120–150), preserving purpose/authority/rules #1–15/routing/gates/retrieval hierarchy/session-end handoff.
- The `<cli> --help` reminder from xtrm-wiy5n.1.1 also lands in the slim.
- Specialists repo release cut with the slim.
- Re-vendor into xtrm-tools: bump `.xtrm/specialists-source.json` version + hash for `using-specialists/SKILL.md`.
- Re-add `'using-specialists': { max: 150 }` to `scripts/check-skill-root-budget.mjs` in xtrm-tools.

## SCOPE

- `~/dev/specialists/config/skills/using-specialists/SKILL.md` (edit in specialists repo)
- `~/dev/specialists/…` release/tag bump
- `.xtrm/specialists-source.json` in xtrm-tools (re-vendor bump)
- `scripts/check-skill-root-budget.mjs` in xtrm-tools (re-enable using-specialists row)

## NON_GOALS

- Slimming other specialists-owned skills — that's the specialists lane's separate scope.
- Changing rules #1–15 or the router shape.

## CONSTRAINTS

- Ownership rule: edit specialists repo FIRST, then vendor.
- Re-vendor lands in a separate xtrm-tools PR after the specialists release cut.
- Preserve every reference in `references/*.md` (they already carry the removed content).

## VALIDATION

- [ ] `wc -l ~/dev/specialists/config/skills/using-specialists/SKILL.md` ≤ 150
- [ ] Specialists release published
- [ ] `npm run check:specialists-vendor` in xtrm-tools passes with new hash
- [ ] `npm run check:skill-root-budget` in xtrm-tools passes with using-specialists re-enabled
- [ ] No regression in specialists chain behavior (spot-check with a small dispatch)

## OUTPUT

Two PRs (one in specialists, one in xtrm-tools re-vendor + budget-check row) + updated using-specialists row in the audit-reconcile epic delta table.
source.title: using-specialists: slim root to 120–150 lines
